Kid Rock tells Fox News Digital that Erika Kirk's emotional tribute at Charlie Kirk's memorial drove him closer to God and inspired his gospel album, "Halfway 2 Jesus," he feared could destroy his career.

Kid Rock harvested an incredible elk, and poked some fun at the state of politics in America in the process.

The popular musician is known for never holding back when it comes to social media, his beliefs or saying what's on his mind at any given time.

His authenticity is one of the major reasons he's built such an incredible following over the past decades.
